name: Saikyou Onna Kishi o Ijou Kairaku Zuke ~Ou o Hitojichi ni Kyousei Acme Jigoku~
original_name: 最強女騎士を異常快楽漬け～王を人質に強制アクメ地獄～
source:
Rifa, a distinguished female swordsman in the Caphile Kingdom, continuously captures the praise of people. Kishis, the leader of the royal bodyguard, doesn't like it. He lost a match against her in the presence of the king, and ever since he has been holding a grudge.

He finally decides to put his revenge plan into action. Taking advantage of her absolute loyal sentiment to the king, he uses a magic on the king to make him give humiliating orders to her!
Her strong resistance becomes weaker and weaker...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088327.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
莉法是卡菲尔王国首屈一指的女剑士，屡立战功，深受民众赞誉。王家亲卫队队长基西斯却对此极为不满。他曾在国王面前的比武中败给莉法，从此一直怀恨在心。

基西斯终于决定实施复仇计划。他利用莉法对国王绝对忠诚的弱点，对国王施下魔法，借国王之口向她下达种种屈辱命令！
莉法起初顽强抵抗，意志却渐渐变得薄弱……
